newsitem.title: USA: Murphy Oil sets stock div ratio for spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Murphy Oil sets stock div ratio for spinoff.

text.p: Murphy Oil Corp said Tuesday its board has declared a dividend of one share of Deltic Timber Corp stock for every 3.5 shares of Murphy stock.
Murphy said the record date is December 2, and the date for distribution and mailing is December 31.
Deltic Timber Corp will be the reincorporated company created by the spin-off of Murphy's farm, timber and real estate subsidiary, Deltic Farm & Timber Co Inc.
The New York Stock Exchange has cleared Deltic to file its listing application for trading on the exchange under the symbol "DEL," Murphy said.
Murphy said it will become a focused oil and gas company after the spinoff.
